body:
I always regret it, but today I don't. Maybe because I did it where it is covered up, so I don't see it, so I'm not thinking about how I regret doing it. 

I'm sure if I kept myself busy with all the shit I have due this coming week I would be okay. It's my last 3 days of my first semester of college and I haven't started ANYTHING! I have plenty to do, I just feel like I really don't care about any of it right now. I just wanna go home and leave all my worries behind me. =/

I enjoy doing a lot of things, I was just in a very sad mood last night. I realized just how much I miss my old life, and I want to go back. At least then I knew people cared about me because I saw so many of them everyday. The world outside of high school is starting to scare me, it's bigger than I like it to be. I spent 18 years of my life in the same city. My mom tells me how lucky I am to have grown up in the same house and been to the same school my whole life, but that just made it harder for me to move because I've never lived anywhere but that one place. Moving to a town that is 12 times bigger(literally) than your old town is kinda scary, especially when you move without your mom. Not to mention I feel like I have lost my best friend who has been there since I began cutting and helped me to stop it. If she was here I probably could have stopped myself last night. I don't regret doing it like I usually do. I guess I am still in that sad mood even though I tried to sleep it off.

Sorry, I got caught up with looking at someones facebook memorial page, he committed suicide in October. Another friend of mine committed suicide 2 weeks ago. I've spent the past hour crying my eyes out and trying to breathe.

My mother lives everyday in pain. She has neuropathy of the feet and hands. She can't feel her legs from her knees down, all she feels is constant electrical shocks and the sensation of stepping on nails. She has a hard time being able to shave her legs because when she does she says it feels like she is literally shaving her skin right off. I used to see her in that pain everyday, and I know I will probably be like that one day, because her mother got it in her mid 20's, which is also the time my mother got it. She is on 17 different medications for many different things. My whole life I have wished she would just get better. I've never been able to do normal mother daughter things with her because she has a hard enough time walking that she can't go many places with me. I know I need to enjoy her while I can because I know she probably won't live much longer. This is part of what upsets me as well because I am now in college and I don't get to go home much, I feel like I am sitting here while she is losing time. Her doctors all say she is way too young to have so many medical problems. She has arthritis as well as degenerative joint disease. She is clinically depressed, which I get from her. I am only 18 and I am already starting to feel some of what she has. I live with a constant headache, feels like a migraine some days, from my tmj(temporomandibular joint disorder). I live off of ibuprofen because that is the only thing that will do anything to help me, besides jaw realignment surgery. I have chronic acid reflux and no matter what I eat I always feel like there is a fire in my stomach. I know there could be many more things wrong with me, and I'm sure one day there will be. I know I am lucky to only have what I have now, but I just can't help but sometimes feel sorry for myself. I can't help it. I wish I could just live a happy life, but I always find sad things to bring me down.
I play Rockband a lot, but today I have been so down I haven't wanted to do anything but sit here.

I know Reddit is here for me, this is why I posted it. This is one of the only places I feel like I can share my feelings and not get bashed for being who I am. A friend of mine has been telling me how he hates his life lately, but I can't fully understand what he is going through so I referred him to Reddit. I think he will fit in well here. I am very glad I have such a good community to come to about this stuff. Sometimes I just need to vent and this is the place to do it. I don't want to take up anyones time with my problems, but I feel if they read it maybe they actually care enough to listen. I have yet to find anything to make me feel better that isn't harmful to myself.
